parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that snprintf is called with the full size of the buffer (BUFFER_SIZE) and that it truncates output when the combined length of the format string and the supplied path would exceed 4095 bytes. Since snprintf guarantees that it writes at most sizeof(request)-1 characters and always null-terminates, the request buffer cannot overflow. The subsequent use of strlen(request) on the resulting string is safe because the string is null-terminated. Therefore the reported buffer overflow cannot occur.
